recipe_version.title: Philly Cheesesteaks with Griddled Onions and Provolone
recipe_version.description: Thin-shaved ribeye seared hard on a hot griddle, chopped with sweet browned onions, blanketed with melting provolone, and scooped into toasted hoagie rolls. Served with crunchy dill pickle spears and pickled pepper rings.

ingredients.name: shaved ribeye steak
ingredients.display_name: thinly shaved ribeye (sold as shaved steak)

ingredients.name: hoagie rolls
ingredients.display_name: soft 8-inch seedless hoagie rolls whose label lists no soy, milk, egg, or sesame
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no soy (including soy flour or soy lecithin), milk, egg, or sesame
ingredients.preparation: split, not all the way through

ingredients.name: pickled pepper rings
ingredients.display_name: pickled banana pepper or cherry pepper rings

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Slice the onions thin. Split the rolls lengthwise, leaving one side hinged. Pull the shaved steak apart into loose pieces and season with 1 tsp salt and the pepper.

steps.title: Griddle the onions
steps.body: Heat the griddle over medium and add 1 1/2 tbsp oil. Cook the onions with 1/4 tsp salt, turning often, until soft and browned at the edges, 12 minutes. Push them to the cool side of the griddle.

steps.title: Toast the rolls
steps.body: While the onions finish, open the rolls and lay them cut side down on a clear part of the griddle for 1 to 2 minutes until golden; set aside. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Sear and chop the steak
steps.body: Raise the heat to high, add 1 1/2 tbsp oil, and spread half the steak in a thin layer. Sear 1 minute, then chop and turn with two spatulas for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked. Repeat with the rest, then mix all the steak with the onions and divide into 4 roll-length piles.

steps.title: Melt and fill
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium-low. Lay 2 slices of provolone over each pile and let them melt, about 1 minute. Set an open roll face-down over each pile, slide a spatula underneath, and flip the whole thing into the roll.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve at once with pickle spears and pickled pepper rings.
